fact: Revenue Services Lesotho and Standard Lesotho Bank launched on 11 February 2026 an integrated e-payment system letting taxpayers pay taxes electronically by USSD, internet banking and the bank's mobile app.

fact: Revenue Services Lesotho says individuals and businesses can pay Corporate Income Tax, PAYE, VAT and customs duties electronically through the new RSL-SLB e-payment system.
